candidates.description: This feature vector is related to society, sociology, and social structures.
This feature vector represents historical totalitarianism, fascism, and 20th-century political dictatorships.
This vector represents common European language suffixes and word stems, heavily featuring German and Romance language morphemes.
This vector activates on proper noun name endings, suffixes, and fragments associated with historical figures, philosophers, and ideological terms.
This feature vector activates on common verb roots, prefixes, and derivational morphemes associated with action and transformation.
This feature vector represents common grammatical articles and short prepositions across multiple European and Middle Eastern languages.
This vector represents common German grammatical articles, conjunctions, and connective adverbs.
This vector activates for common Italian grammatical words, pronouns, and prepositions.
This vector is related to punctuation marks combined with quotation marks and parentheses at the end of sentences or clauses.
This feature vector represents common Italian adjectival and participial suffixes.
